PHASE 13 E2E round 10 (run 36629953091 artifacts + logcat timeline): cap15 failed both passes — NOT the dodge this time. PHASE 13 E2E round 11 (run 36640751137): cap15 both passes again — the round-10 stream bound covered only the FIRST call. Timeline: harness round 1 executed the search at 23:36:19 (steps recorded) but round 2 complete() trickled 17 MINUTES (23:36→23:53) — complete() rides an SSE stream internally, so every read timeout stays quiet on a token-every-few-seconds trickle. Fixes: (1) streamed first call now bounded by the IDLE GAP between deltas (STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS=120s via Flow.timeout) — healthy long essays keep flowing, stalls cut; (2) every harness model call (runTurn + appendContinuations) wrapped in withTimeout(PER_MODEL_CALL_TIMEOUT_MS=480s) — TimeoutCancellationException aborts the attempt, caller fallback chain (forced search → honesty note) takes over, recorded steps stay visible. 715/715 local green.

ROOT FIX: the SSE pump now polls currentCoroutineContext().ensureActive() every 16 lines — cancellation/timeout lands within a few lines of the deadline. 715/715 local green.
